t: 斯考特斯王公"布鲁斯"的罗伯特·克明(Robert the Bruce)在因弗鲁里之战中果断地…
te: Robert the Bruce, king of Scots, defeats John Comyn, earl of Buchan, decisively in the battle of Inverurie.
dz: 斯考特斯王公"布鲁斯"的罗伯特·克明(Robert the Bruce)在因弗鲁里之战中果断地击败了布昌之耳的约翰·克明.
de: Robert the Bruce, king of Scots, defeats John Comyn, earl of Buchan, decisively in the battle of Inverurie.

t: 在对圣殿骑士团领袖的审讯结束时,三位教宗调查员,红衣主教贝伦格·弗雷多尔,艾蒂安·德·苏伊西和…
te: At the conclusion of the interrogation of the leaders of the Knights Templar, the three papal investigators, Cardinals …
dz: 在对圣殿骑士团领袖的审讯结束时,三位教宗调查员,红衣主教贝伦格·弗雷多尔,艾蒂安·德·苏伊西和兰多尔福·布兰卡奇写了"奇农·帕克通",他们在书中确认被控告的圣殿骑士团已经认罪,做了忏悔,并被免除了异端罪.
de: At the conclusion of the interrogation of the leaders of the Knights Templar, the three papal investigators, Cardinals Bérenger Frédol, Etienne de Suisy and Landolfo Brancacci, write the "Chinon Parchment", in which they affirm that the accused Templars had confessed, done penance, and were absolved of heresy.

t: 日本花之野皇帝的统治开始.
te: The reign of Emperor Hanazono of Japan begins.
dz: 日本花之野皇帝的统治开始.
de: The reign of Emperor Hanazono of Japan begins.
